name: Delivery to the Gnomes
label: Quest
description: Kravel Koalbeard now has what he needs, and wants the Delicate Car Parts carried to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats, who has waited a long time…
intro: Kravel Koalbeard now has what he needs, and wants the Delicate Car Parts carried to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats, who has waited a long time for them. Kravel admits he removed a little piece from Fizzle's order, and suggests you leave it unmentioned.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that I have what I need, give these parts to Fizzle Brassbolts. He's been waiting a long time for them -- I'm sure he won't miss the little piece I removed from his order...
And I wouldn't bother mentioning it to him. It was small and worthless.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have something for me? That's great! Let's see it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: There they are! My hydro ratchets and repeater bolts! These will do just fine. Thank you!
